brief.concept: Can ChatGPT Analyze Player Props? A Better Research Prompt, Its Limits, and a Smarter Workflow
brief.primary_question: Can ChatGPT help research a player prop, and what prompt and verification workflow keep it from becoming a source of confident guessing?
brief.audience: Sports and DFS/pick'em users who use a general AI assistant, plus prospective Propeller users seeking a repeatable player-prop research process.
brief.learning_outcome: Viewers can build a specific skeptical prompt, require fresh sources and counterarguments, recognize a valid no-action outcome, and separately inspect the current line and available evidence in Propeller.
brief.cta: Build a free research prompt at https://propellerpicks.com/tools/ai-betting-prompt-builder/, then verify the current player-prop context in the free Prop Analyzer at https://propellerpicks.com/analyzer/.
brief.freshness_requirements: Use the current prompt builder for the primary walkthrough. Capture matching current desktop and mobile analyzer states close to render; label any historical detail capture permanently and do not show an active recommendation.
